DG: Round 9 ratings after neutralizing the two DG-C vignettes.
UG: Original round 8 ratings; no rerating used in the manuscript.
TG: Original round 8 ratings; no rerating used in the manuscript.
confidence_intervals: Two-sided 95% Student-t intervals across the three agent-level estimates from the corresponding round (df=2).
structural_point_estimator: Original estimator: average vignette points across agents, calculate family mean points per vignette, then normalize the three family means. CI widths use the variation in the three agent-specific normalized analogues.
